Feelings should not only appear in words used in sentences or paragraphs but the whole conversation should feel emotional to convey how this new found passion brings positive emotions for this friend.

I’ve got this little secret to spill and if my other hobby was baking cupcakes for a local fair last winter and now I love going to a local market every morning just as it starts getting bright. I have started to pick up fresh fruits and herbs and spend some hours making these lovely and healthy jams to share and to gift, and I am absolutely loving how much my hands have grown accustomed. The way they feel in my little wooden spoon is a delight; and when you look at those mason bottles full to my shoulders I get these warm, flutter feelings that you just have no concept, because it reminds me a great day in my grandma home.

Oh, you should really come by when we next see, it might help me share some with a good pal who is missing out. 

P. 

p.s.- Do let your mom I’m sending the best vibes to both and that the best jam will be coming their direction. 🫧

🌟Sending love to your life, and hope
